003import java.io.IOException;

017/**
018 * There is one monitor thread running during the simulation. It keeps track of
019 * the number of threads in use and available memory. If there is available
020 * memory it will poll for a new simulation to be created by the factory. If
021 * there are queued simulations ready to be run it will spawn a new thread and
022 * execute them (individual simulations will be processed in parallel also).
023 */
024public class SimulationMonitor implements Runnable {
025
026        private static final long WAIT_FOR_MEMORY = 5 * 60 * 1000;
027        // reserve at least 512Mb for system
028        private static final long RESERVE = 512 * 1024 * 1024;
029
030        static SystemInfo si = new SystemInfo();
031        static GlobalMemory hal = si.getHardware()
032                .getMemory();
033        static Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SimulationMonitor.class);
034
035        /**
036         * Get a string describing the current free memory in the system and JVM.
037         * This is used for logging and debugging purposes to monitor memory usage
038         * during the simulation.
039         *
040         * @return a formatted string showing free memory in GB, used memory in GB
041         *         and percentage, and available system memory in GB
042         */
043        public static String freeMemG() {
044                var sys = ((float) hal.getAvailable()) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
045                var freeHeap = ((float) Runtime.getRuntime()
046                        .freeMemory()) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
047                var maxHeap = ((float) Runtime.getRuntime()
048                        .maxMemory()) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
049                var currentHeap = ((float) Runtime.getRuntime()
050                        .totalMemory()) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
051                var allocatable = Math.min(maxHeap - currentHeap, sys);
052                var allocated = currentHeap - freeHeap;
053                return String.format(
054                        "%1.2f Gb remaining; %1.2f Gb used (%1.2f%%) [%1.2f Gb system]",
055                        allocatable + freeHeap,
056                        allocated,
057                        allocated / (currentHeap + allocatable) * 100,
058                        sys
059                );
060        }
061
062        /**
063         * Calculate the proportion of used memory to available memory, taking into
064         * account both JVM heap and system memory. This is used to determine when to
065         * throttle the simulation factory or execution due to low memory conditions.
066         *
067         * @param sysReserved the amount of system memory (in bytes) to reserve for
068         *                    non-simulation processes
069         * @return the proportion of used memory to available memory, as a value
070         *         between 0 and 1
071         */
072        public static double usedOfAvailable(long sysReserved) {
073
074                var sysAvail = ((float) hal.getAvailable() - sysReserved)
075                                / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
076                var freeHeap = ((float) Runtime.getRuntime()
077                        .freeMemory()) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
078                var maxHeap = ((float) Runtime.getRuntime()
079                        .maxMemory()) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
080                var currentHeap = ((float) Runtime.getRuntime()
081                        .totalMemory()) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
082                var allocatable = Math.min(maxHeap - currentHeap, sysAvail);
083                var allocated = currentHeap - freeHeap;
084                return allocated / (currentHeap + allocatable);
085        }
086
087        SimulationFactory factory;
088        SimulationExporter exporter;
089        int duration;
090        Object trigger = new Object();
091        volatile private boolean halt = false;
092//      private ExperimentConfiguration config;
093//      private Path baseDirectory;
094        private Path outputDirectory;
095        private Path workingDirectory;
096
097        /**
098         * Create a new SimulationMonitor with the given configuration and base
099         * directory for output. This will initialise the simulation factory and
100         * exporter based on the provided configuration, and write the input
101         * configuration to the output directory.
102         *
103         * @param config        the experiment configuration containing setup and
104         *                      execution details
105         * @param baseDirectory the base directory for output files generated by the
106         *                      exporter
107         * @throws IOException if there is an error writing the input configuration
108         *                     or initialising the exporter
109         */
110        public SimulationMonitor(ExperimentConfiguration config, Path baseDirectory)
111                        throws IOException {
112
113//              this.config = config;
114//              this.baseDirectory = baseDirectory;
115                this.outputDirectory = config.getBatchDirectoryPath(baseDirectory);
116                this.workingDirectory = config
117                        .getBatchDirectoryPath(config.getWorkingBaseDirectory(baseDirectory));
118                Files.createDirectories(this.outputDirectory);
119                Files.createDirectories(this.workingDirectory);
120
121                this.exporter = config.exporter(this.workingDirectory);
122
123                this.exporter.writeInputConfiguration(config);
124                var setups = config.getBatchSetupList();
125                var executions = config.getExecution();
126                this.factory = SimulationFactory.startFactory(
127                        setups,
128                        executions,
129                        config.getBatchConfig()
130                                .getUrnBase(),
131                        this
132                );
133                this.duration = config.getBatchConfig()
134                        .getSimulationDuration();
135        }
136
137        /**
138         * Handle exceptions that occur during the simulation. This will set the halt
139         * flag to true to signal the monitor to stop processing, and print the stack
140         * trace of the exception for debugging purposes.
141         *
142         * @param e the exception that occurred during the simulation
143         */
144        public void handle(Exception e) {
145                this.halt = true;
146                e.printStackTrace();
147        }
148
149        private boolean isRunning(SimulationExecutor ex) {
150                return ex != null && !ex.getState()
151                        .equals(State.TERMINATED);
152        }
153
154        /**
155         * Notify the monitor that a simulation execution has completed. This will
156         * log the status of the executor and notify any waiting threads that may be
157         * waiting for a simulation to complete or a new simulation to be queued.
158         *
159         * @param executor the SimulationExecutor that has completed execution
160         */
161        protected void notifyExecutionComplete(SimulationExecutor executor) {
162                log.info("Execution complete: " + executor.status());
163                synchronized (this.trigger) {
164                        this.trigger.notifyAll();
165                }
166        }
167
168        /**
169         * Notify the monitor that a new simulation is ready to be executed. This
170         * will log the status of the factory and notify any waiting threads that may
171         * be waiting for a simulation to complete or a new simulation to be queued.
172         *
173         * @param factory the SimulationFactory that has a new simulation ready for
174         *                execution
175         */
176        protected void notifyFactoryReady(SimulationFactory factory) {
177                log.info("Build complete: " + factory.status());
178                synchronized (this.trigger) {
179                        this.trigger.notifyAll();
180                }
181        }
182
183        @Override
184        public void run() {
185                SimulationExecutor executor = null;
186                try {
187
188                        double freeSysGb = hal.getAvailable() / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
189
190                        var abortTime = Long.MAX_VALUE;
191
192                        while (!this.factory.finished() || this.isRunning(executor)) {
193
194                                if (this.halt) { break; }
195
196                                var checkAgainInMs = 1000;
197                                // long memLimit = factory.getSimulationSize().orElse(0);
198
199                                if (usedOfAvailable(RESERVE) > 0.80 || freeSysGb < 1) {
200                                        this.factory.pause();
201                                        log.warn(
202                                                "Low memory. Throttling factory production. Memory: "
203                                                                + freeMemG()
204                                        );
205                                } else {
206                                        // This will only be successful if the cache is not already full;
207                                        this.factory.unpause();
208                                }
209
210                                if (usedOfAvailable(RESERVE) > 0.90 || freeSysGb < 0.5) {
211                                        System.gc();
212                                        abortTime = Math
213                                                .min(abortTime, System.currentTimeMillis() + WAIT_FOR_MEMORY);
214                                        if (executor != null) {
215                                                executor.pause();
216                                                log.warn(
217                                                        "Very low memory. Throttling simulation execution. Memory: "
218                                                                        + freeMemG()
219                                                );
220                                        } else {
221                                                log.warn(
222                                                        "Very low memory. Delaying simulation execution. Memory: "
223                                                                        + freeMemG()
224                                                );
225                                        }
226                                        log.warn(
227                                                "Aborting in "
228                                                                + (abortTime - System.currentTimeMillis()) / 1000
229                                                                + " secs unless memory improves"
230                                        );
231                                        log.info("Exporters: " + this.exporter.report());
232
233                                        if (this.exporter.allWaiting()) {
234                                                log.warn(
235                                                        "Exporters all empty. Trying to clear simulation despite very low memory."
236                                                );
237                                                if (executor != null) { executor.unpause(); }
238                                        }
239
240                                        checkAgainInMs = 1000;
241
242                                } else {
243                                        abortTime = Long.MAX_VALUE;
244                                        if (this.isRunning(executor)) {
245                                                executor.unpause();
246                                        } else {
247                                                if (executor != null) {
248                                                        // Executor is not running because it is complete
249                                                        // log the final state:
250                                                        log.info(executor.status());
251                                                        executor = null;
252                                                }
253                                                // Start a new simulation
254                                                if (this.factory.ready()) {
255                                                        executor = new SimulationExecutor(
256                                                                        this, this.factory.deliver(), this.exporter,
257                                                                        this.duration
258                                                        );
259                                                        executor.start();
260                                                        log.info("Starting new simulation");
261                                                } else {
262                                                        log.warn("Waiting for simulation to run");
263                                                        this.factory.unpause();
264                                                        checkAgainInMs = 1000;
265                                                }
266                                        }
267                                }
268
269                                if (usedOfAvailable(RESERVE) > 0.95 || freeSysGb < 0.25) {
270
271                                        if (this.exporter.allWaiting()
272                                                        && (executor == null || executor.isWaiting())
273                                                        && this.factory.isWaiting()) {
274                                                log.error(
275                                                        "Critically low memory. All processes blocked. Terminating early: "
276                                                                        + freeMemG()
277                                                );
278                                                throw new InterruptedException("Out of memory");
279                                        }
280                                        log.warn(
281                                                "Critically low memory. Waiting for exporters to clear backlog.: "
282                                                                + freeMemG()
283                                        );
284                                        System.gc();
285                                        checkAgainInMs = 1000;
286
287                                }
288
289                                log.info("Factory: " + this.factory.status());
290                                if (this.isRunning(executor)) {
291                                        log.info("Executor: " + executor.status() + " - " + freeMemG());
292                                }
293
294                                // Sleep the monitor thread until a simulation finishes or a
295                                // new simulation is queued.
296                                if (System.currentTimeMillis() > abortTime) {
297                                        log.error(
298                                                "Low memory has not been cleared after "
299                                                                + WAIT_FOR_MEMORY / 1000 + " seconds. Aborting"
300                                        );
301                                        break;
302                                }
303                                this.waitForEvent(checkAgainInMs);
304                        }
305                        this.exporter.finaliseAll();
306                        while (!this.exporter.allWaiting()) {
307                                log.info("Waiting for output to complete...");
308                                Thread.sleep(1000);
309                        }
310
311                        if (!this.outputDirectory.equals(this.workingDirectory)) {
312                                try {
313                                        var success = Files.walk(this.workingDirectory)
314                                                .parallel()
315                                                .filter(Files::isRegularFile)
316                                                .mapToInt(in -> {
317                                                        var rel = this.workingDirectory.relativize(in);
318                                                        var target = this.outputDirectory.resolve(rel);
319                                                        try {
320                                                                log.info("Copying simulation working file: " + in);
321                                                                Files.createDirectories(target.getParent());
322                                                                Files.copy(
323                                                                        in,
324                                                                        target,
325                                                                        StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING
326                                                                );
327                                                                log.info("Copy complete: " + in + "->" + target);
328                                                        } catch (IOException e) {
329                                                                log.error(
330                                                                        "Failed to copy working file: " + in + "->" + target
331                                                                                        + ": " + e.getCause()
332                                                                                                .getMessage()
333                                                                );
334                                                                return 0;
335                                                        }
336                                                        return 1;
337                                                })
338                                                .allMatch(i -> i == 1);
339                                        if (!success)
340                                                throw new IOException("Copy failed one or more files.");
341                                } catch (IOException e) {
342                                        log.error("Failed to copy working files: " + e.getMessage());
343                                }
344
345                        }
346
347                        SimulationMonitor.log.info("Completed.");
348
349                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
350                        e.printStackTrace();
351                } finally {
352                        if (this.factory != null) { this.factory.halt(); }
353                        if (this.exporter != null) { this.exporter.close(); }
354                        if (executor != null) { executor.halt(); }
355                }
356        }
357
358        private void waitForEvent(long ms) throws InterruptedException {
359                synchronized (this.trigger) {
360                        this.trigger.wait(ms);
361                }
362        }
363
364}
